Migration complete. Build succeeded, all routes produced as expected.

**Pages → App Router mapping:**

| Pages Router | App Router |
|---|---|
| `pages/_app.js` + `pages/_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx:1` (root layout with `<html>`/`<body>`) |
| `pages/index.js` (getServerSideProps) | `app/page.tsx:1` (async server component) |
| `pages/blog/index.js` (getStaticProps ISR) | `app/blog/page.tsx:1` (`fetch(..., { next: { revalidate: 60 } })`) |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` (getStaticPaths/Props, fallback: 'blocking') | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx:1` (`generateStaticParams` + `dynamicParams = true` + `revalidate: 300`) |
| `pages/404.js` | `app/not-found.tsx:1` |
| `pages/_error.js` | `app/error.tsx:1` |
| `pages/api/posts/index.js` | `app/api/posts/route.ts:1` |
| `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts:1` |
| `next/head` | `metadata` / `generateMetadata` exports |
| `next/router` (`useRouter`) | `next/navigation` (`useRouter`) — co-located in client components (`ViewPostsButton.tsx`, `ReadMoreButton.tsx`, `BackButton.tsx`) |
| `<a href>` for internal nav | `next/link` `<Link>` |
| `req.query`, `req.body`, `res.json()` | `await params`, `await req.json()`, `NextResponse.json()` |
| `components/AppProvider.js` | `components/AppProvider.tsx:1` (typed) |

**Final structure:**
- `app/` — routes, layouts, route handlers, client components
- `components/AppProvider.tsx` — typed client provider
- `styles/globals.css` — imported in `app/layout.tsx`
- `pages/` — removed entirely
